items.text:
‼️ BREAKING: Recently patched N-central servers remain exploitable under certain conditions.

"4EverAble2Shell" enables unauthenticated root RCE; "Agent2Shell" can run Windows SYSTEM commands with the appliance ID.

Attackers are probing. N-able is investigating.

Details: https://t.co/t3tenC9MPi

🚨 Just TWO unauthenticated requests can set up a MongoDB server crash.

A critical pre-auth flaw (CVE-2026-118383, CVSS 9.5) can crash vulnerable replica set members during failover.

No login required. Patches are out.

Details: https://t.co/sNxCLv20F1
